Title: Azure Container Registry firewall rules and Virtual Network (in preview)

Body.Content:
Firewall rules and Virtual Network support in Azure Container Registry are now available in preview.  Limit registry access to your resources in Azure, or specific on-premises resources, including Express Route connected devices. Virtual Network access is provided through the Azure Container Registry premium tier. General availability pricing will be announced at a later date.
